# Security policy

Please report security problems privately, not in public issues.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: on this repository, open the
**Security** tab and choose **Report a vulnerability**. Include the macOS version,
the SentryScreen version (Settings › App), and steps to reproduce.

We will acknowledge the report, keep you informed, and credit you in the fix's
release notes unless you prefer otherwise.

Bypasses that let a Standard (child) account stop protection, remove covers, or
read or change parent settings are in scope, as is anything that makes SentryScreen
send data other than an owner-approved diagnostic report. Missed detections by the
model are not security issues; open a regular issue without attaching the content.
